name: lockin-design-system
description: Lock In Design System — tokens, components, specs and an MCP hub for humans and AI agents, on web and mobile.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lockin/tokens && npm run build -w @lockin/icons && npm run build -w @lockin/specs && npm run build -w @lockin/react && npm run build -w @lockin/react-native && npm run build -w @lockin/storybook
scripts.check: npm run check:contrast -w @lockin/tokens && npm run validate -w @lockin/specs && npm run typecheck -w @lockin/react && npm run typecheck -w @lockin/react-native && npm run typecheck -w @lockin/server && npm run typecheck -w @lockin/storybook
